day_focus: Guard the Sabbath—worship, rest, and unhurried presence with Maria and the kids; leave the open loops alone until Monday.
checkin: Son, today the board is cleared on purpose. No sorties to push, no half-steps to force—just show up to the Lord, then show up to your people. Maria needs your attention more than your hustle, and the Watch crew needs a dad who is actually home, not half-working. Rest is not laziness here; it is obedience.
